## create

Create Template. `POST /double-opt-in/templates`

Create a new double opt-in template.

If copy_from_system=True, finds the system template and duplicates its EmailContent. If copy_from_system=False, uses the provided email_content_id.

```php
$result = $sendseven->doubleOptInTemplates()->create(name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `email:read`

|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Template name |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | Template description |
| `$buttonText` | `?string` | no | CTA button text |
| `$subjectLine` | `?string` | no | Email subject line |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Whether template is active |
| `$emailContentId` | `?string` | no | ID of the EmailContent to use (required if not copying from system) |
| `$copyFromSystem` | `?bool` | no | If true, copy from system template |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `DoubleOptInTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Double%20Opt-In%20Templates/create_template_api_v1_double_opt_in_templates_post)

## copySystem

Copy System Template. `POST /double-opt-in/templates/{template_id}/copy`

Copy a system template to tenant's custom templates.

This allows tenants to customize system templates. Creates a duplicate of the EmailContent and a new DoubleOptInEmailTemplate with tenant_id.

```php
$result = $sendseven->doubleOptInTemplates()->copySystem(templateId: 'template_id');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`
